title: Astronomers record the supernova that made the Crab Nebula
summary: Chinese astronomers of the Song court recorded a guest star bright enough to be seen in daylight for weeks. It was the explosion that left the Crab Nebula.
reason: A massive star in the constellation Taurus ended its life in a supernova.
significance: Its records let modern astronomers date the Crab Nebula and its pulsar exactly.
